verdict.rationale: Browserbase provides managed serverless browser sessions with SDKs, Stagehand scripts, scheduled/on-demand agent deployment, webhooks, and file management, letting developers build and run custom scraping scripts without managing browser infrastructure (docs-1,4,14,18,19,22). Independent community reaction is limited to general praise rather than deep technical corroboration. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of deployment/scaling at scale, and more detail on pricing/limits for serverless execution.
